This process requires detailed observation and clear documentation. Below are step-by-step instructions for documenting failsduring vehicle brake testing.

### 1. Prepare Inspection Records

Before the inspection begins, prepare all necessary forms and records to document the results of the Brake Test. Make sure you have:

  • Vehicle Inspection Reportsor: Inspection checklist specific to brakes.
  • Standard Forms: if required for local regulations.

### 2. Evaluate pretest conditions

Location and Preparation:

  • Inspect Environment: Ensure the test area is clean and free of debris.
  • Test vehicle settings: Make sure the vehicle is in proper working condition with no silhouette obstructing brake function.
